import json, urllib.request

def get_json(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as r:
        assert r.status == 200, f"status={r.status}"
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())

# 1. Inspect TASK-9 ("tích hợp Master MongoDB Destination")
d9 = get_json("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-9")
print("TASK-9 active_task_key:", d9["active_task_key"], "stage:", d9["active_task_stage"], "repo:", d9["active_target_repo"])
assert d9["active_task_key"] == "TASK-9"
assert d9["active_task_stage"] == "NEEDS_YOU", f"expected NEEDS_YOU, got {d9[\"active_task_stage\"]}"
assert "centralized-data-service" in d9["active_target_repo"]
assert d9["active_agent_kernel"]["total_lessons"] >= 268
assert len(d9["active_agent_kernel"]["matched_lessons"]) >= 3
assert len(d9["active_sub_tasks"]) >= 4
assert len(d9["active_step_reports"]) == 5
s3 = [r for r in d9["active_step_reports"] if r["step_id"] == "S3"][0]
assert "UpsertMasterBatch" in s3["code_demo"]
assert len(d9["available_repos"]) >= 4

# 2. Verify 100% right-window scoping when switching between TASK-1 and TASK-2
d1 = get_json("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-1")
d2 = get_json("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-2")
assert d1["active_task_key"] == "TASK-1" and d2["active_task_key"] == "TASK-2"
for cyc in d1["autopilot_cycles"]:
    for row in cyc.get("rows") or []:
        assert row["task_key"] == "TASK-1", f"leaked {row[\"task_key\"]} in TASK-1 cycles"
for pane in d2["agent_panes"]:
    assert pane["active_task_key"] == "TASK-2", f"leaked {pane[\"active_task_key\"]} in TASK-2 panes"

# 3. Re-focus TASK-9 so UI opens directly on TASK-9 at NEEDS_YOU with S3 Code Demo
d9_final = get_json("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard?task_key=TASK-9")
print("RUNTIME VERIFIED OK: total_lessons=", d9_final["active_agent_kernel"]["total_lessons"], "repos=", len(d9_final["available_repos"]), "subtasks=", len(d9_final["active_sub_tasks"]))
